description: Defines the VmapMode struct in the at::impl namespace, which manages thread-local vmap nesting levels for the torch.vmap API, including functions to get, increment, and decrement the vmap level.

classes.name: VmapMode
classes.description: Manages thread-local nesting levels for the torch.vmap API, providing methods to query and modify the current vmap depth.

methods.name: current_vmap_level
methods.description: Returns the current depth of nested vmap calls in the current thread.

methods.name: increment_nesting
methods.description: Increments the vmap nesting level, enabling VmapMode dispatch key if level > 0.

methods.name: decrement_nesting
methods.description: Decrements the vmap nesting level, disabling VmapMode dispatch key if level reaches 0.
